180-metre six-span bridge over the Malwa river. The municipal corporation has
commissioned the bridge and will open it to traffic after the reviewer signs.

design standard, and the compliance statement. Each role files one item per

reviewer records a decision. The cycle has six exchanges; once you file, your

arguments.note: The design report and geotechnical investigation indicate that the foundation soil consists of loose sand susceptible to scour, and IRC:78 clause 703.3.1 requires a scour computation for the design flood with protection works dimensioned accordingly. The package contains only a placeholder for the scour assessment (Appendix D.4) and no actual scour calculation or protection dimensions. Consequently, the submission does not satisfy the design standard. The finding is flagged for the reviewer to obtain the required scour computation before opening the bridge to traffic.
